title: Cat51: Season Era Normalization
summary: Normalize each team's rolling efficiency stats (ORtg, DRtg, pace, net rating) against the league-wide running average FOR THIS SEASON. This removes era drift: the league averaged ~98 ORtg in 2018-19 but ~115 ORtg in 2025-26 due to rule changes and pace evolution. Without era normalization, a team's 'good' ORtg in 2025-26 looks different than the same raw number in 2018-19, confusing models trained on multi-season data.

research_basis.finding: Season-fixed effects applied to handle era differences. Logistic regression with these features achieved Brier 0.199. Quote: 'Efficiency normalization: Points standardized per 100 possessions to remove pace effects; season-fixed effects applied to handle era differences.'

research_basis.source: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (MDPI Jan 2026)
research_basis.finding: Rolling 5-game lagged aggregates with strict temporal shifts to prevent lookahead bias. Season-fixed effects remove era-level confounds.

feature_semantics.era51_h_ortg_vs_league: Home team's 10-game rolling ORtg z-scored vs all teams' ORtg in this season so far. Positive = above-average offense this era.
feature_semantics.era51_h_drtg_vs_league: Home team's DRtg z-scored vs league. NEGATIVE = better defense (lower DRtg is better).
feature_semantics.era51_a_ortg_vs_league: Away team's offense quality relative to this season's league context.
feature_semantics.era51_a_drtg_vs_league: Away team's defense quality relative to this season's league context.
feature_semantics.era51_h_pace_vs_league: Home team runs faster/slower than league this season. Affects style-clash features.
feature_semantics.era51_a_pace_vs_league: Away team pace in league context.
feature_semantics.era51_h_netrtg_vs_league: Home net rating (ORtg - DRtg) z-scored vs league net rating distribution this season. Best single-number team quality signal.
feature_semantics.era51_h_ortg_a_drtg_edge: Offensive advantage: h_ortg_z - a_drtg_z. Captures matchup quality: strong offense vs weak defense.

implementation.key_design_decision: Running per-season tracker (_era51_ortg, _era51_drtg, etc.) updated AFTER feature extraction for each game — ensures no lookahead bias. League averages for game G use only games before G in same season.

expected_mechanism: The GA will discover that era51_h_netrtg_vs_league (net rating in season context) and era51_h_ortg_a_drtg_edge (matchup offensive advantage) are stronger predictors than raw ORtg/DRtg, especially for games across seasons where league scoring level differs.
validation_plan: Monitor next 5 cycles — check if era51_h_netrtg_vs_league or era51_h_ortg_a_drtg_edge appear in any island's selected feature set. If yes → confirmed useful. The era51_h_ortg_a_drtg_edge feature is the most likely to be selected (directly captures offensive vs defensive matchup quality).

cross_project_applicability.political: Era normalization concept applies to political Brier scoring if we normalize political event outcomes by regime context (Trump 1.0 vs Trump 2.0 regulatory environments). Deferred pending NBA validation.
